source.method: Genuine Rack Engine with actual pinned MidSide class and one eight-input sink, linked against genuine Rack SDK2.6.6 library. Use actual Engine.addCable/removeCable/bypassModule and actual Engine.hasCable for consumer observations. No independently reimplemented SDK lifecycle oracle. The Rust exporter composes the actual production 17-initial-count transform and applies it once; it must not replay a separate expected-state mirror.

scope.reason: No process, processBypass, Engine step or DSP sample is executed. No MidSide encoder/decoder numerical equivalence, timing, audio, performance, callback deadline, device or GUI claim follows from this producer-port lifecycle proof.
scope.initialization: Each independent case begins unbypassed with fresh legal cable/count configuration. Remove old cables, create actual initial cables, then set connected output counts to supplied1..16 using SDK API. Disconnected counts are0. Seed all64 raw slots only after counts settle. Raw values are finite exact f32, including signed zero and inactive nonzero storage. These are explicit legal Port storage seeds, not a claim every tuple is reachable from MidSide DSP or an ordinary public host patch.
scope.module: Actual MidSide has four outputs, no configured bypass routes and no lifecycle callback overrides. Public/unstable SDK port storage initialization is disclosed. Sink input storage and cable propagation are outside this proof.
scope.event_semantics: C/D mean ensure one particular cable present/absent and are guarded by actual hasCable; repeated requests are no-ops. A port's physical connection edge occurs only when its total consumers cross zero. B toggles actual bypass; B0/B1 assign false/true and same-state assignments are no-ops. There are zero DSP steps between operations. Intermediate states are not individually emitted; every single-target word prefix is independently represented as its own complete case. Supplemental multi-port words are a fixed bounded inventory, not exhaustive arbitrary multi-port histories.

input_protocol.format: One independent case per whitespace-separated line. Integer fields decimal; raw f32 values round-trip decimals with signed zero preserved.
input_protocol.raw_order: Output-major,16 raw lanes per output, including inactive slots.
input_protocol.cable_mask: 8 bits: bit(port*2+slot), two consumers per output. Count0 iff neither initial bit is set for that output; otherwise count1..16. Initial bypass is false for every case.
input_protocol.engine_objects: MidSide module id1; eight-input Sink id2; cable id100+port*2+slot connects output port to Sink input port*2+slot. IDs are adapter identities, not signal semantics.

output_protocol.observation: Read actual producer Port counts/raw16, module.isBypassed and Engine.hasCable for every cable identity. No fabricated counts, no zero-padding or sanitization of raw SDK/Rust producer storage. All64 raw slots, including disconnected/inactive slots, are compared.
output_protocol.gate: Exact integer equality and exact IEEE754f32 bits, including signed zero, on all70 final fields for every case. No tolerances, warmup, discarded rows, skipped histories or inactive-lane exclusions.

source_law.first_cable: Only the physical zero-to-positive consumer edge sets output.channels=1. It leaves all raw values unchanged.
source_law.last_cable: Only the physical positive-to-zero consumer edge sets output.channels=0. It leaves all raw values unchanged.
source_law.nonedge_cables: Adding an additional consumer or removing a nonlast consumer preserves the producer channel count and all raw values.
source_law.bypass_edge: Both bypass and unbypass call output.setChannels(0) on every output. If disconnected this is a no-op. If connected it clears exactly [0,prior_count) to positive zero, preserves higher raw slots, and sets count1. A later reconnect can reduce a subsequent clear extent; event order therefore matters.
source_law.same_bypass: Engine returns before touching storage when requested bypass state already matches.

coverage.independent_words: For each of4 targets and each initial count0..16, every word over C(target,slot0),D(target,slot0),B of lengths0..7:4*17*3280=223040 cases. Positive initial count has precisely its slot0 cable. Other outputs begin count0 without consumers but contain seeded raw storage.
coverage.multi_consumer_cross_port: All16 initial port-presence masks with heterogeneous positive counts[1,3,7,16], one slot0 consumer per present port;120 explicitly frozen scripts per mask cover second consumers, nonlast/last removals, handovers, all-port actions, both bypass states, assignments/no-ops and ordered cross-port actions.
coverage.independent_anchors: 14 literal hand-derived histories, each under both seed profiles, specify final counts, exact clear-prefix lengths, bypass and cable mask. They expose disconnect-before/after-bypass, reconnect versus nonlast handover, initial two-consumer state and same-state bypass assignment after connecting while bypassed.
coverage.seed_profiles: Profile0 has all64 nonzero signed dyadic values of magnitude1/8..8. Profile1 replaces lane mod4=0 by negative zero and lane mod4=1 by positive zero, retaining other dyadics. Profile alternates by case index; anchors use both profiles. No double Cartesian expansion or implicit random seed.

independent_checks: Generated input identity, legal initial connection/count relation, exactly70+N input fields and70 output fields, complete EOF, finite raw state, integer bounds.
Final cable membership and bypass state from independent control-assignment bookkeeping, conditional count/consumer agreement and count constrained to0,1,or its initial value.

Each raw result is its original seed bit pattern or positive zero; lanes beyond max(initial_count,1) cannot be cleared by these events. Literal hand anchors specify which prefix actually clears without implementing a general lifecycle evaluator.

All70 actual SDK/production fields compare exactly. Streaming validation retains at most16 detailed failing cases and aggregate mismatches; failures must be retained and cause the runner to exit nonzero.
provenance: Freeze acceptance/generator/manifest/validator/README before first Engine execution. Record hashes of all five, full current Core source closure, exporter/SDK adapter, actual source files/license, SDK headers/library, compiler commands and binaries, inputs and both traces. Adapter must assert/report actual Engine frame remains0; the70-field wire alone cannot prove no DSP calls. Preserve unused precomparison corrections and every failed execution. No edits to acceptance based on observed outcomes.
limitations: This is a bounded producer-storage lifecycle contract, not MidSide DSP qualification or full Rack/OpenPatch host equivalence.
Only one no-override four-output module, two consumers per port, declared initial legal storage/count states, exhaustive single-target words through length7 and frozen supplemental words are covered.

No sample-time progression, input/cable transfer, sanitization, tapped-output host policy, concurrent thread interleaving, failed event delivery, module removal, or onPortChange/onBypass custom override behavior is qualified.
Internal producer raw storage is deliberately distinguished from public PortFrame padding and signal-consumer storage; this proof does not authorize blanket host padding changes.
